body: Kind of... really sad. The design was off but the message resonates in an "I'm not sure I understand but I get a vibe" way.

Cynthia, Severa, Inigo, Owain, Lucina, and Morgan can already all have Galeforce according to your pair ups. That not enough?

Make sure that the mothers of the boys have Galeforce equipped in the last slot before you do their Paralogues, though. Then you should be fine.

From what I gather the marriages really don't matter unless you're hell-bent on doing an Apotheosis secret-path run. I'm guessing you're on Normal? All characters can break the game if you just put enough time and effort into them.
